title: Time off and holidays
text: Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave each calendar year. Submit vacation requests through the People portal at least five working days before departure. A manager approves the request within two working days. Unused leave carries forward up to a maximum of five days. Sick leave does not reduce the annual vacation allowance.

title: Expense reimbursement
text: Submit an itemized receipt and business purpose for every expense claim. The finance team reimburses approved expenses within ten business days. Meals during approved travel are covered up to 40 credits per day. Personal purchases are not reimbursable. Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the purchase.

title: Support response times
text: Urgent production incidents receive an initial response within 15 minutes, 24 hours a day. Standard support tickets receive a first response within one business day. The support desk is open Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 UTC. Include the request ID and a description of the problem; never include passwords or API keys in a ticket.

title: Backup and recovery
text: Production databases are backed up every six hours. Encrypted backups are retained for 35 days. Recovery exercises run every month using an isolated staging environment. The recovery time objective is two hours. After restoring a backup, operators verify record counts and application health before returning traffic.

title: New teammate checklist
text: New teammates receive a company laptop before their first working day. During the first week, complete account setup, security training, and an introduction with the assigned onboarding buddy. Hardware issues should be reported to the IT help desk. The buddy schedules a check-in at the end of the first month.

title: Release process
text: Every production release requires passing automated tests and approval from one reviewer. Deployments begin in staging, then send five percent of production traffic to the new version for 20 minutes. If the error rate exceeds one percent, roll back to the previous version. Publish release notes after the rollout completes.

title: Account access
text: Access to internal systems follows the principle of least privilege. Multi-factor authentication is required for every employee account. A team lead approves access requests; permissions are reviewed every quarter. When a teammate leaves, the IT team revokes account access by the end of the final working day.

title: Remote work
text: Teammates may work remotely up to three days each week. Keep the shared team calendar current and be available during the core collaboration window from 10:00 to 14:00 UTC. Managers can approve a different schedule for another time zone. The remote-work equipment allowance is 300 credits per year.

title: Data retention
text: Application logs are retained for 30 days. Audit records are retained for one year. Customer documents are deleted within seven days after a confirmed deletion request. Retention jobs run nightly and produce an auditable deletion report. Do not place credentials or personal payment details in application logs.

title: Meeting guidelines
text: Every meeting invitation should include an agenda and the decision it needs to support. The default meeting length is 25 minutes. Share a written summary with decisions and owners afterward. Wednesday afternoons are reserved for focused work; use asynchronous updates during that period.

title: Learning budget
text: Each teammate has a learning budget of 600 credits per calendar year for approved courses, books, and conferences. Obtain manager approval before making a purchase. Learning expenses use the regular reimbursement process. Unused learning funds do not carry forward to the next year.

title: Incident escalation
text: The on-call engineer starts an incident channel and names an incident coordinator. Escalate to the engineering lead if customer impact lasts more than 30 minutes. The coordinator posts a status update every 20 minutes. Complete a blameless incident review within five working days after resolution.
